settle_proposal_unavailable.issuer_preauthorisation_absent: {publisher} has not authorised a confirmation for this product yet, so there is nothing to confirm on your wallet. Their team needs to send it; nothing was changed.

settle_proposal_unavailable.face_settle_proposal_release_changed: {publisher}'s confirmation was prepared for an earlier version of their app. Their team needs to send a new one; nothing was changed.

launch_full.journal_full: The {publisher} application has reached its request limit, so nothing was sent for this request. Restart the application to continue. A transfer step your wallet already sent is checked again when it restarts and is never sent twice.

You can still view the application here, but not send requests from this window. Finish an unfinished request in a window of the application that is already open, or try again later.
